ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is heavily skewed toward low-intensity (black) pixels; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to less than 3% of the surface area, primarily at the distal tips and in linear streaks.
